C run013.lg-structured OL RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Use structured message templates; avoid interpolation (opaque text, allocations when disabled); keep property names stable so logs stay queryable. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.lg-levels EX RUN-013 DEFINITION ;; Choose log levels by operational meaning: Trace/Debug diagnostics (not safe for sensitive data), Information meaningful events (not every call), Warning recovered/degraded conditions, Error failed operations needing investigation, Critical when the application or a subsystem cannot continue. ;; = ;; none ;; Log-level semantics not in the oracle.
C x.lg-correlation EX RUN-013 PREFER ;; Prefer platform/runtime trace identifiers; add an explicit correlation identifier only for an integration or operational requirement; propagate tracing context across outbound calls with the chosen tracing/HTTP infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;; Correlation guidance not in the oracle.
C sec003.lg-validate-correlation OL SEC-003 MUST ;; Validate or normalize a correlation identifier accepted from an external client before propagating it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run014.lg-no-headers-bodies OL RUN-014,SEC-010 MUST_NOT ;; Keep authorization headers and full request/response bodies out of logs (never-log data is owned by the security standard). ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.lg-loggermessage OL RUN-008,RUN-001 DEFAULT ;; Normal structured ILogger calls suffice; source-generated LoggerMessage only for measured high-volume hot paths, not everywhere by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.lg-no-audit-db EX RUN-014 AVOID ;; Do not use logs as an audit database without a dedicated audit design. ;; = ;; Dedicated audit design. ;; No owner clause for this item.

C dep021.sl-ilogger OL DEP-021 MUST ;; Application code keeps using ILogger<T>; direct Serilog APIs (Log.Logger, LogContext) stay at composition or provider-specific boundaries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep021.sl-addserilog OL DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; AddSerilog() integrates with DI (ReadFrom.Services), replacing the older builder.Host.UseSerilog(). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-bootstrap EX DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; Use a two-stage bootstrap logger when startup failures before DI/configuration need to be captured; simpler applications can skip it. ;; = ;; Simpler applications. ;; Bootstrap-logger guidance not in the oracle.
C x.sl-flush EX DEP-021 MUST ;; When the static/bootstrap Log.Logger is used, flush it on shutdown (try/finally with CloseAndFlushAsync). ;; = ;; Purely host-managed logging follows the provider lifetime. ;; Flush requirement not in the oracle.
C dep021.sl-config OL DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; Keep levels, sinks and overrides in configuration so they can differ per environment. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-sinks-optional EX DEP-001,DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; File, Seq and other sinks are not baseline dependencies; a Console sink suffices for a simple local Development baseline; example limits and retention values are illustrative. ;; = ;; none ;; Sink-baseline guidance not in the oracle.
C x.sl-destructure-limits EX RUN-014 DEFAULT ;; Limit destructuring of large object graphs or transform types to specific properties. ;; = ;; none ;; Destructuring guidance not in the oracle.
C x.sl-elastic-deprecated EX DEP-004 MUST_NOT ;; Serilog.Sinks.Elasticsearch is deprecated; use the official Elastic.Serilog.Sinks package. ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete deprecated-package guidance not in the oracle.

C run009.mc-when-clearer OL RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Use a modern feature when it makes code clearer, safer or simpler, not to demonstrate syntax. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-collection-expr EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Use collection expressions when the target type is clear. ;; = ;; none ;; Collection-expression guidance not in the oracle.
C x.mc-required EX ARC-004,API-010 DEFINITION ;; required expresses a construction contract and does not replace constructor or domain validation where invariants need protection. ;; = ;; none ;; required-member semantics not in the oracle.
C run008.mc-raw-strings-not-sql OL RUN-008 MUST_NOT ;; Raw string literals suit test JSON, templates and SQL that belongs in code, but are not a reason to write raw SQL. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-immutability EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Model immutability where it is natural; framework models and controlled-mutation workflows often stay simpler mutable. ;; = ;; none ;; Immutability guidance not in the oracle.
C run008.mc-spans OL RUN-008,RUN-012 DEFAULT ;; Span<T>, stackalloc, pooling, source-generated serialization and preallocated buffers are for demonstrated allocation-heavy hot paths with verified improvement; ordinary arrays, strings and collections are the default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-langversion EX DEP-008,ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Confirm the configured language version supports a feature before using it; changing LangVersion or the target framework to use newer syntax is a decision, not a silent edit. ;; = ;; none ;; LangVersion/TFM decision gate beyond DEP-008's preview/RC rule.
C run011.mc-modernization OL RUN-011,GOV-014,RUN-009 MUST ;; When explicitly asked to modernize: preserve behaviour, keep the change focused, favour readability, build and test afterwards, keep architecture refactoring out of syntax modernization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-mistakes EX RUN-008,RUN-009 AVOID ;; Avoid record struct merely to avoid allocations and deeply nested patterns. ;; = ;; none ;; No owner clause for these items.

C arc027.bl-real-dirs OL ARC-027 MUST ;; Default physical backend structure; create only directories that contain real code. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc005.bl-ddd-dirs OL ARC-005,ARC-004 MUST_NOT ;; DDD-oriented Domain directories (ValueObjects, DomainServices, Events, Exceptions) only when an approved design justifies them; business rules or workflows alone do not. ;; = ;; Approved design. ;;
C arc014.bl-persistence-abstractions OL ARC-007,ARC-008,ARC-016 MUST ;; Application/Abstractions/Persistence holds inward-facing persistence contracts (repositories, IUnitOfWork) with no EF Core types. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc007.bl-external-abstractions OL ARC-007 MUST ;; Application/Abstractions/ExternalServices holds Application-owned abstractions implemented by outer layers, created when such a dependency exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc009.bl-no-cqrs-structures OL ARC-006,ARC-009 MUST_NOT ;; Application/Services holds Application Services and service contracts; no handler, CQRS or MediatR structures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc029.bl-dtos OL ARC-029,ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Application DTOs are operation/data models when useful, not a dumping ground. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api010.bl-validation OL API-010 DEFINITION ;; Application/Validation holds FluentValidation validators for Application-level input and use-case validation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.bl-app-di OL ARC-023,ARC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Application DependencyInjection.cs registers Application services and validation infrastructure, never concrete Infrastructure implementations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bl-type-roles EX RUN-024 MUST ;; Make each supporting type's responsibility clear from its name, directory or both (role suffixes; e.g. TaskWorkflowRules over TaskWorkflow); add responsibility subdirectories only when a flat feature directory becomes hard to navigate. ;; = ;; none ;; Type-role naming convention not in the oracle.
C arc027.bl-no-generic-buckets OL ARC-027 AVOID ;; Avoid generic Models, Helpers, Common or Utils buckets when a specific responsibility can be named. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc015.bl-infra-dirs OL ARC-015,PST-003 DEFINITION ;; Infrastructure Configurations (EF mappings), Repositories (Infrastructure-only generic base allowed when it removes real duplication), Migrations, Seeding (Development initialization). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc007.bl-infra-services OL ARC-007 DEFINITION ;; Infrastructure Services hold technical/external implementations of Application abstractions, with capability subdirectories when they improve cohesion. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.bl-infra-di OL ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Infrastructure DependencyInjection.cs registers AppDbContext, repositories, IUnitOfWork, adapters, the SQL Server provider and HttpClient/resilience integrations when used. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc010.bl-controllers OL ARC-010 DEFAULT ;; Api Controllers are thin ASP.NET Core Controllers; no Minimal API endpoint groups unless explicitly requested. ;; = ;; Explicit request. ;;
C arc029.bl-contracts OL ARC-029 DEFINITION ;; Api Contracts hold request/response contracts when used. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.bl-only-when OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; A Middleware directory exists only when custom middleware exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bl-extensions EX ARC-012,GOV-012 MUST_NOT ;; Api Extensions hold cohesive API/composition extension methods; do not move arbitrary code out of Program.cs just to shorten it. ;; = ;; none ;; Program.cs extraction rule not in the oracle.
C arc012.bl-program OL ARC-012 DEFAULT ;; Program.cs is the composition root (AddApplication, AddInfrastructure). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.bl-never-outward OL ARC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Never add Domain→Application, Domain→Infrastructure or Application→Infrastructure references; reconsider the abstraction boundary; check-dependencies checks the references. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst006.bl-integration-transitive OL TST-006 DEFINITION ;; Integration tests exercise Application, Infrastructure, EF Core, routing, DI, serialization and persistence transitively through the API host. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.bl-no-tests-dir OL DEP-024 MUST_NOT ;; Backend tests never go into a separate top-level tests/ directory. ;; = ;; none ;;

C dep003.bs-via-add-dependency OL DEP-002,DEP-003 MUST ;; Package and technology selection comes from the decision register; install every package through add-dependency with the version resolved at install time. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bs-baseline-packages EX DEP-013,DEP-009,DEP-010 MUST ;; New applications install the packages each decision names plus scaffold packages: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design where migrations are created (provider in Infrastructure, Api as startup project), a Console sink for a simple local logging baseline (Api), NUnit3TestAdapter and Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk in test projects. ;; new applications ;; none ;; Concrete scaffold package set not in the oracle.
C dep001.bs-conditional OL DEP-001,DEP-011 MUST_NOT ;; Conditional packages (D-11 to D-15) are added only when their capability is needed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep026.bs-dev-connection OL DEP-026 DEFAULT ;; appsettings.Development.json carries a usable, credential-free local connection string (adapt the database name). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep026.bs-credentials OL DEP-026,SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; When local SQL Server needs credentials keep the non-secret structure in configuration and supply the secret through user-secrets or another approved local mechanism; never commit usernames/passwords, tokens, production hosts or production connection strings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api017.bs-swagger-dev OL API-017,DEP-012 DEFAULT ;; Expose Swagger UI at /swagger in Development. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bs-launch-profile EX WF-006,DEP-012 DEFAULT ;; Set the launch profile to open Swagger (launchBrowser true, launchUrl swagger) with application URLs matching the profile. ;; = ;; none ;; Launch-profile configuration not in the oracle.
C dep014.bs-angular-cli OL DEP-014,DEP-016 DECIDED ;; Use the latest stable Angular supported by the selected Node.js and create the workspace with the current Angular CLI (compatible Angular/TypeScript/RxJS; no independent TypeScript upgrade beyond the supported range); standalone, strict, routing, SCSS, zoneless when supported; Material/CDK via the CLI; the decided unit-test runner; E2E only under D-13. ;; = ;; none ;;
